description: Defines the DnsConfig structure which stores configuration settings for the system DNS resolver, including nameservers, DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS settings, search domains, and various resolver options.

classes.name: DnsConfig
classes.description: Stores DNS resolver configuration including nameservers, DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-HTTPS, search domains, and various operational flags.

methods.name: DnsConfig(std::vector<IPEndPoint> nameservers)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a list of nameservers.

methods.name: ToDict
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representation of the configuration.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is valid (has nameservers or DoH servers).
